title: A class of low-rank short recurrences for nonsymmetric linear matrix equations
summary: We propose a new class of short matrix recurrences for the solution of nonsymmetric linear equations of the type $\mathbf{A}_1\mathbf{X}\mathbf{B}_1+\ldots+\mathbf{A}_p\mathbf{X}\mathbf{B}_p=CD^T$. Building on ideas underpinning the recently introduced subspace conjugate gradient algorithm, we derive low-rank short recurrences that generalize one-dimensional subspace projection methods to the nonsymmetric matrix equation setting.
